Both bugs have been fixed: 1) Discount calculation uses round() for exact results (3% of 17000 = 510), 2) Split payment validation prevents silent debt creation by validating payment totals match sale total on both frontend and backend.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend _calculate_discount() uses round() for accurate percentage calculations
Frontend validates split payment totals before API call (lines 1129-1137)

Debt requires customer selection - properly rejected without customer

discount_calculation.root_cause: Integer truncation or incorrect rounding in percentage calculation
discount_calculation.reproduction: 3% of 17000 should be 510 but was showing 500
discount_calculation.mitigation: Used Python's round() function which rounds to nearest integer correctly

split_payment_debt.root_cause: No validation on frontend or backend to ensure split payment amounts sum to sale total
split_payment_debt.reproduction: Enter split payment amounts that don't match total - debt created without warning
split_payment_debt.mitigation: Frontend validates before submit (shows error toast), Backend detects mismatch and creates explicit debt or rejects if no customer
